text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} and Nea had arrived to the
meeting place where the duel would take
place. Having obtained a clue to unleashing
her "true power", Nea finally confronts
Kariza.
text_block_list.orig_text:
決闘の待ち合わせ場所にたどり着いた{0}たち。
真の力を引き出す手がかりを得たネアは、
ついにカリザと対峙する。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Heyas, Kariza-kyun. Sorry for the wait. Hmm?
You seem to be in a bad mood... Were you
feeling lonely without me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっす～
カリザきゅん。
おまた～
ン？　
こりゃ
ご機嫌ナナメっぽー
ネアおねえちゃんいなくて
寂しかったん～？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
DO-NOT-MESS-WITH-ME! You're LATE!! How long
were you planning to keep me waiting? Hah...
Let's get this over with!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ・
ざ・
け・
ん・
な！　
遅ぇんだよ！！
どんだけ待たせりゃ気が済むんだ！！
とっとと始めっぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What kind of weak talk even is that? I'm
obviously going to beat her to a pulp and
kill her. It's a freaking DUEL, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？　
何ぬるいコト言ってんだ。
ボコして
ブチ殺すに決まってんだろ。
決闘なんだからよ。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Mmmm~♡ An impatient and fed up Kariza-kyun,
how cute~♡ Makes me want to make you wait a
little longer, but that'd be cruel. Okay,
let's begin~ Duel~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン～♡　
ガマンできなくてジレてるカリザきゅん
カワゆいな～♡
もちょい待たせてみたかったけど～
それもカワイソっか。
んじゃ。
はじめよっか～
決・
闘♡

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day your arrogance comes to an
end! Take this, Kiiro! ORAAAAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text:
調子に乗れんのも今日までだっ！
くらえキイロ！　
おらぁ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfufufufu... Good going♪ I think I'll be able
to get serious today♪ Ready for this?
Kariza-kyu~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
イイじゃん♪
今日はアタシもガチれっかなー♪
覚悟できてるー？　
カリザきゅ──

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
WHOAAAA?! WH-WHAT THE HELL IS THIS?! What's
going on...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おわぁっ！？　
な、
なんだよこれ！
何が起きてんだ……！？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
This must be the "Wall", right?! Why is it
suddenly... Oh crap, it's sucking us in~
text_block_list.orig_text:
コレ例の『カベ』じゃね！？　
何でいきなり……
って
やべ、
吸い込まれ──

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ That was fun~♪ Time went by so fast~ I
wish I could've played with Zataro-kyun...
Kariza-kyun, even more~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
楽しかった～♪　
時間過ぎんの早すぎ～
もっと座太郎きゅんこと、
カリザきゅんと遊びたかったな～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's his curfew, guess it can't be
helped~ Kariza-kyun's super cute and all, so
his parents are probably worried about
weirdos getting too close to him, right~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まー
門限ならしゃーねーか～
カリザきゅん
カワゆいしなー
パパママも
カリザきゅんに変な虫つかねーか
心配だろーし～？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Knight-kyun, you don't have a curfew, right?
Since we're here, shall we play a little
longer?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士きゅんはダイジョーブ、
門限？
せっかくだし、
もーちょい遊ぶ？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ By the way, could we maybe go to your
house? There's a little somethiiiiing I wanna
do~ So-me-thi-ng G-O-O-D~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
やりー♪
ちな、
騎士きゅん家って
行けるカンジ？
ちょ～
っとヤリたいコトあんだよね～　
イ・
イ・
コ・
ト♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
I see. So this is Knight-kyun's room, huh?
Hehehe, it's surprisingly tidy~♪ Found your
bed♪ Diiiive♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほどー
これが騎士きゅんの部屋か～
ンフフ・
意外と片付いてんね～♪
ベッド発見♪　
ダーイブ♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Afuuu... It smells so good♪ It's so relaxing~
I can't move anymore~ I could fall asleep
like this~♡ Would you like to join me,
Knight-kyun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～
イイにおい♪
癒される～　
もー動けね～
このまま寝れるわ～♡　
騎士きゅんも一緒にどー？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ah, crap. This bed's allure almost caused me
to forget~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ・
やべ。
ベッドの罠で
忘れるとこだったじゃん～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
If you're asking what I'd like to do in your
room... there's only one thing it could be,
"that thing"♡ Now, show it to Big Sis...
"that thing"♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士きゅんのお部屋で
ヤリたいことって言ったら～
アレしかないっしょ、
アレ♡
おねえちゃんに見せてみ、
ア・
レ♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Geez, don't make me say it~♡ I'm talking
about Knight-kyun's... photo album, of
course~ The one from your "shota (little
boy)" days~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
も～
言わせんなって～♡
騎士きゅんの
写真アルバムしかないっしょ～
もち、
ショタ時代のやつ～♪

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Craaaap~♡ Shota Knight-kyun's just too cute~
Isn't a bandage on your kneecap such a
classic trope~♡?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やば～♡
ショタ騎士きゅん、
きゃわいすぎ～
膝小僧に絆創膏とか
テッパンすぎんか～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
These photos from the sports day are
seriously amazing! I'll take some pictures♪
Oh, this one's awesome too, isn't it? I'll
have to treasure it forever♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちの運動会の写真とか、
マジハナヂもんだわ～
写真とっとこー♪　
あっ
これもヤバじゃね？
家宝にするっきゃねぇ～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah... Asking me such a hard question out
of the blue... Do I like the current you or
the shota you more...? Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わーぉ？
いきなしムズイこと聞くじゃん。
今かショタか、
どっちが好みかってコト？　
ンー……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Of course, shota Knight-kyun... I wonder...?
Knight-kyun plus shota should be the ultimate
combo... right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もち、
ショタの騎士きゅん……
なのかなー……？
騎士きゅんだし
ショタだし、
最強コンボ……
じゃん？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
But, you know... a full combo like that
should be perfect, yet... saying that with
certainty feels a bit unsettling, doesn't it?
Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもなー、
フルコンボでカンペキなはずなんだが
そう言い切っちゃうのも、
モヤるっつーか？
ン～～……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfu, is that so? But well, I guess so~
Because Knight-kyun in this photo is a super
cute shota~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
そーなん？
でもま、
そーなんだよね～
だって
写真の中の騎士きゅんは
めちゃカワのショタだけど～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
My favorite is the current Knight-kyun. You
don't have a bandage on your knee anymore,
your voice isn't all high-pitched, and your
skin's not as soft and squishy as it used to
be, but even so... I love the current
Knight-kyun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシの好きぴは
今の騎士きゅんで。
膝小僧の絆創膏とかないしー、
声もソプラノじゃねーしー
お肌のもちもちとかも違うけど、
そんでも
騎士きゅんがイイんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
But then again, shota Knight-kyun in the
photos looks perfect visually... and thinking
about that kinda scrambles my brain a bit~
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも写真のショタ騎士きゅんは
ビジュサイコーで～
って
考えると、
頭ン中
ぐちゃってきちってさ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I want both♡ But... lately I've
been thinking. Maybe "what you're into" and
"who you love" aren't the same thing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショージキ
どっちも欲しー♡　
んだけど。
けど……
最近考えんだよね。
好きぴと好み？　
ってのは
別なんじゃね？　
って。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't totally get it myself, but...
ever since I met you, Knight-kyun, I've kinda
started feeling that way~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー……
アタシにもよくわからんけど～
騎士きゅんと出会ってから
なんとなく
そんな気ィしてきたっていうか～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I mean... you're not a shota, but...
you're still the one I love, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん。
だって、
騎士きゅんショタじゃねーけど、
アタシの好きぴじゃん？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you know... remember how I struggled
a while back thinking how Kariza-kyun would
stop being a shota?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにさー
カリザきゅんがいつかショタじゃなくなるからって
焦って
イロイロと足掻いたこともあったっしょ？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on it now, maybe I was worried
that if he stopped being my "type" I'd lose
interest in him altogether.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アレもさ、
今思えば
好みのタイプってやつじゃなくなったら
キョーミもなくなるかも～
みたいなのが
怖かったんかなーって。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Like... If I were to think that grown-up
Kariza-kyun wasn't cute, then I might realize
that all this fooling around we're doing now
doesn't really mean anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
デカくなったカリザきゅんが
カワいー
って思えなくなっちゃったら
今こんなにラブラブしてんの、
ホントは意味なんかねーって
わかっちゃうかもじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
But. I like the shota Kariza-kyun, sure...
and you're not a shota, Knight-kyun, but
you're still the one I love.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ケド、
アタシはショタのカリザきゅんが好きだし～
騎士きゅんはショタじゃね～けど
アタシの好きぴで～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Even when Kariza-kyun grows out of being a
shota, I'll still dote on him... and I love
you whether it's the you now or your shota
self, y'know? So... I guess everything's
fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショタじゃなくなっても
カリザきゅんのコトはカワいがるし～
ショタの騎士きゅんのコトも
スキだし？
それはそれでイんじゃねー
って。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Lemme see... if you set aside stuff like "my
type" and appearances... isn't it enough to
just go, "I love what I love"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー
っとー……
好みのタイプとか、
そーゆうガワとか置いといて、
スキなもんはスキ、
ってことでよくね？　
ってハナシ。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Sure, there are things you lose when someone
stops being a shota, and yeah, that's kinda a
shame... but still, if you love someone, you
just accept it, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショタじゃなくなったら
なくなるモンもいっぱいあるし
それはもったいねーケド。
ま、
スキなモンは受け入れるしかねーっしょ。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I got to meet you, Knight-kyun... the
one I love, even though you're not a shota.
So that doesn't change the fact that I'm
gonna spoil you rotten♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショタじゃねー
好きぴの騎士きゅんと出会えたんだし？
ねっちりみっちり
カワいがるコトにはかわりねーって♡
開眼したってカンジ♪

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfufufu... thank you~ Oops, I got a little
carried away talking there... kinda
embarrassing~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフ・
せんきゅ～
ちっと語っちった～　
ハズー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Well, who knows how things'll turn out,
though. Even I can't control my heart... or
my tastes, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
どーなるかはわかんないけどねー
自分でも、
心とかセーヘキって
コントロールできないし？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: So, if you're asking which I prefer...
text_block_list.orig_text:
てわけで～
どっちが好みか、
ってと……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Shota Knight-kyun is just my type~ But the
one I actually love... is the Knight-kyun
right in front of me now~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショタ騎士きゅんは
あくまでタイプで～
スキなのは、
今、
アタシの目の前にいる
騎士きゅんかな～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
And... I guess what I really feel right now
is that I wanna keep doting on Kariza-kyun
for a long, long time too~
text_block_list.orig_text:
んで。
カリザきゅんも末永く
カワいがってやりてーってのが、
今のアタシの本心かな～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? Hearing you say that makes me
believe it too♡ Alright then, let's give
shape to this determination~
text_block_list.orig_text:
マ？　
騎士きゅんにそー言ってもらえると
イケる気がしてくんね♡
んじゃ
今のうちに形にしとこ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Well, we'll just have to do it our own way,
right? Anyway, let's go crash Kariza-kyun's
house tomorrow~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃ、
アタシたちらしくやるしかねーじゃん？
とりま、
明日カリザきゅん家に凸ろ～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day──
text_block_list.orig_text: そして翌日──

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Come on, now~ Cram in a little more~ If you
don't squeeze in, the shot won't come out
right, y'know? It's our first purikura
together, we've gotta make it cute♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほれほれ、
もっと詰めて詰めて～
くっつかないと、
上手く撮れんっしょ～？
３人の初プリなんだから
カワイくせんと♪

text_block_list.name: Zatarō
text_block_list.text:
L-Let me go! Why the hell do I have to do
this?! I never said anything about taking
purikura! And you! Don't just stand there,
help me out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ
放せ！　
オレがなんでこんなことしなくちゃならねーんだ！
プリやるなんてひとっことも言ってねーぞっ！
テメーもテメーだよっ！　
見てねーで助けろ！

text_block_list.name: 寝亜
text_block_list.text:
そー
さっき説明したっしょ～？
text_block_list.orig_text:
そー
さっき説明したっしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Zatarō
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, I have no idea what the hell
you're talking about! I don't like you
bastards! So hurry up and let go already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが意味わかんねーって言ってんだろーがっ！
オレは
テメーらなんか、好きじゃねー！
とっとと放せ！

text_block_list.name: Zatarō
text_block_list.text:
Actually... bastard! HOW THE HELL DID YOU
KNOW WHERE I LIVE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか、
テメーら！
何でオレの家知ってんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfufufu~ Didn't we walk you home yesterday
due to your curfew? We followed you from
there~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフ～
昨日、
門限だからって
家の近くまで送ったじゃん？
そっから尾行りました～♡

text_block_list.name: Zatarō
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... that's when... This is the worst...
I have to move...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ、
あん時か……
サイアクだ、
引っ越してー……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like it's starting~ Come on, get
closer~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
もー始まってるー
ほら、
もっとくっついて～♪

text_block_list.name: Zatarō
text_block_list.text:
You're too close...! Stop clinging onto
me...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
近ぇーんだよっ……！
くっつくな……！

text_block_list.name: Zatarō
text_block_list.text: SHUT UP! LIKE I'M DOING A STUPID POSE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせー！
ポーズなんかしねぇよっ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Come on, now~ Kariza-kyun, smile, smile~
Tickle tickle~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほらー
カリザきゅんも笑って笑って～
こちょこちょ～

text_block_list.name: Zatarō
text_block_list.text: Hey, cut it out, idiot! Don't tickle me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バカっ、
やめろっ！
くすぐるんじゃね～……！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's lookin' good~! Alright, let's
doodle on it~
text_block_list.orig_text:
イイカンジじゃ～ん！
んじゃ落書きすっか～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu, there we go~ How is it? Looks good,
right~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフ・
よしっと～
どー？　
イイカンジっしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Zatarō
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't screw with me! What the hell's
wrong with that graffiti you made...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
ふざけんなっ！
何だよこの落書き……！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Right~♡? Our feelings, all nice and visible
now... complete♪ Love♡forever~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
だよねー♡
アタシらの決意の形、
完成～
らぶ♡
ふぉーえばー♪

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that was fun~ Where should I stick our
purikura?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
おもろかったー
プリどこに貼ろー？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
My, my... you all seem to be in quite high
spirits, Nea...
text_block_list.orig_text:
随分と愉し気な様である喃、
寝亜や──

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... if it isn't Big Sis~♪ Perfect
timing! Come take some purikura with us~
Kariza-kyun too, let's do a second round♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
おねえちゃんじゃ～ん♪
ちょーどイイとこ来た、
一緒にプリやろー
カリザきゅんも、
今日二枚目いっとこ♪

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
No. There is no time for such trifling. We
are in the midst of grave danger.
text_block_list.orig_text:
否。
戯れの暇などありんせん。
斯かる危難の最中故──

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Your report that the "Walls Between Worlds"
are weakening seems to have proven true. And
now... you are trapped between those walls,
as proof. From here, all I can do is trace
our connection and send my thoughts to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界を隔てる壁が
脆薄と化したとの報告、
確かなれど……
その亀裂に囚われしは汝ら。
わっちからは、
縁を辿り
思念を送るが精々。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? "Walls"...? Big Sis, what're you
going on about...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン・
カベ……？
おねえちゃん、
何言って……

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Those gaps are but flaws born within the
"Walls" due to the repeated
"Reconstructions". While you drift within
that dreamlike state, you may yet be consumed
by its self-correcting force. Should you
remain asleep... death is certain. Awaken at
once, my foolish little sister.
text_block_list.orig_text:
壁の隙間が
再々構築故の不具合の産物なれば、
夢に揺蕩うているうちに、
自浄作用の餌食になるやもしれぬ。
寝坊したとあらば
落命必定。
疾く目覚めい、
虚けの妹子や。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I slept well... Wait, huh? Weren't we
sucked within that rift... Knight-kyun,
Cariza-kyun, wake up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー……
よく寝たー……
って
あれ？　
ここ、
アタシら
カベに吸い込まれて……
騎士きゅん、
カリザきゅん
起きなー

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, I'm still sleepy... Huh? What the
hell's this place now...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせぇな、
まだ眠てぇんだよ……
あ？　
なんだここ……？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see~... So this is what the inside of
the "Walls Between the Worlds" looks like...
Wait, aren't we actually kind of screwed?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン・
成程ね～
世界の間の壁の、
内側ってヤツか～
……これって実は
ピンチなんじゃね？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
During Nea and Kariza's duel, {0}
and the others were swallowed by a tear in
space. The three of them had been pulled into
a rift that created between the walls that
separated their worlds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネアとカリザの決闘中、
空間にあいた亀裂に飲まれた{0}たち。
３人は世界の壁、
その狭間に吸い込まれていたのだった。
